general_comment: number of questions and some nitpicks

src/maasservicelayer/services/dhcp.py.320: Nit: _get_ha_config raises an error if both primary and secondary rack id are missing, meaning that peer_rack_id will for sure be not a None. This check seems redundant
src/maasservicelayer/services/dhcp.py.328: Nit: Same here, _get_ha_config loads both racks through cached_node so I don't see how peer_rack could ever be none
src/maasservicelayer/services/dhcp.py.532: Since _chached_ips_for_interface can theoretically take a list of interface ids, wouldn't it make sense to extract this call to outside the loop and avoid single quiries for each interface?
src/maasservicelayer/services/dhcp.py.987: In the legacy code the maas url comes from the regiond.conf I believe. Is reading from the database the intented behavior?
